description.value: This Subway franchise sits on Columbia Avenue in Castlegar and offers the full lineup of Footlong and 6" sandwiches, wraps, and salads alongside breakfast options. It features a drive-through lane and supports multiple ordering modes including in-restaurant dining, curbside pickup, and delivery. A convenient calorie stop for cyclists passing through the Castlegar corridor on a long touring day.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Subway website confirms this is an active, open location at 2001 Columbia Ave in Castlegar, BC with phone (250) 365-7826 matching the OSM record. The website lists services including Drive-Thru, Breakfast, and Catering, and confirms takeout/pickup options; neither the website nor OSM tags mention bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi. The OSM community field shows 'Crescent Valley' but the website and OSM addr tags clearly place this in Castlegar.
concerns: OSM community field shows 'Crescent Valley' but the website and OSM address tags place this location in Castlegar — the community field may be a metadata artifact rather than a true location discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Subway franchise confirmed open by its own website; a useful food stop for touring cyclists in Castlegar.
